ec2.application-migration.title: AWS Application Migration Service
limitations: AWS Application Migration Service is a separate AWS product that Vyomi does not implement; the EC2 console shows an honest Not simulated panel.

ec2.image-builder.title: EC2 Image Builder pipelines

aws.vpc.network-manager.title: AWS Network Manager
limitations: Network Manager is a separate, external AWS console (global networks, Transit Gateway registrations); it is not part of the VPC simulation.
